title: NeoForge mods to Fabric through a bridge built from NeoForge's own files
text: Cover NeoForge's whole published API on Fabric instead of fixing mods one at a time: a coverage check against NeoForge's jars and patches (bench/bridge_coverage.py), the methods its patches add to game classes generated for 26.3, 26.1 and 1.21.1 (bench/bridge_generate.py), and NeoForge's own LGPL classes copied into the converted mod when they compile on Fabric, with failing members left out (bench/bridge_import.py).
finish: 14 of 28 corpus mods convert, compile and load in the game (cloud sweep on the final commit)
wrongIf: the copied classes or generated methods break a mod that loaded before, or the count stays at 13
result: 14 of 28 compile and load in the game (was 10 on 2026-11-16), 10 with the same behaviour fingerprint as the original; curios is new. 720 of NeoForge's classes compile on Fabric for 26.3, 714 for 26.1, 568 for 1.21.1.
